title: Zotero 风格研究助手
summary: 在分析页面边读论文边提问，用已有的 MiniMax 或其他模型整理研究笔记。
steps: 在 EMP 10.4 或更高版本，打开「插件」，点击研究助手卡片的「安装并启用」。
在「模型与 API」加载已有的模型，然后在「插件」的已安装列表点击「打开聊天」。
在对话框加入 PDF、摘要或 Markdown，选择「要点」「研究方法」或「局限性」后发送。
note: 设置可选择随屏幕大小、展开或收起。问答与 Agent 共用 EMP 的模型连接。启停保留当前浏览器保存的对话文字。需要 EMP 的 Python AI 服务和可用模型。
permission: chat.panel，使用 EMP 提供的研究对话窗口。
preview_alt: 研究对话示意，展示方法提问与研究笔记。

en.title: Zotero-style research chat
en.summary: Read papers alongside your analysis. Use an existing MiniMax or other model connection to turn a question into a research note.
steps: In EMP 10.4 or later, open Plugins and select Install and enable on the research chat card.
Load a model under Models and API, then select Open chat on the plugin card.
Attach a PDF, abstract or Markdown note. Select Key points, Methodology or Limitations and send your question.
en.note: Choose a collapsed, expanded or screen-adaptive panel in Settings. Chat and Agent share the EMP model connection. Saved conversations remain in this browser after disabling the plugin. A running Python AI service and a configured model are required.
en.permission: chat.panel opens the research chat panel provided by EMP.
en.preview_alt: Illustration of a methods question and a research note.

title: 样本质量概览
summary: 按样本统计观测值、缺失值、均值、标准差和变异系数。
steps: 在 EMP 10.4 或更高版本，打开「插件」，点击此插件的「安装并启用」。
导入实验矩阵，在插件面板选择实验、主 assay 和 Sample quality summary。
点击「运行分析」查看指标。10.2 起可在插件设置中选择需要的指标。
note: 适用于特征为行、样本为列的数值矩阵。变异系数使用标准差除以均值，均值为零时结果为空。
permission: assay.read 读取选定矩阵，job.result.write 写入新任务结果。
preview_alt: 合成样本的质量统计表示例。

en.title: Sample quality summary
en.summary: Calculate observed and missing values, mean, standard deviation and coefficient of variation for each sample.
steps: In EMP 10.4 or later, open Plugins and select Install and enable.
Import a numeric matrix. In Plugins, choose the experiment, primary assay and Sample quality summary.
Select Run analysis. In EMP 10.2 or later, choose the metrics to compute in Settings.
en.note: Use features as rows and samples as columns. The coefficient of variation is the sample standard deviation divided by its mean. A zero mean gives a missing result.
en.permission: assay.read reads the selected matrix. job.result.write saves the new analysis result.
en.preview_alt: Example quality table for synthetic samples.

title: 样本质量条形图
summary: 把结果表里的样本均值画成条形图，快速比较样本间的差异。
steps: 在 EMP 10.4 或更高版本，打开「插件」，点击此插件的「安装并启用」。
选择已完成且含 mean 列的插件任务，例如「样本质量概览」的结果。
选择 Sample quality bars，点击「展示结果」。
note: 默认显示前 30 行。EMP 10.2 起可在设置中切换表格或条形图，并调整行数。
permission: job.result.read 读取所选任务的结果表。
preview_alt: 用与质量统计表相同的合成样本展示均值。

en.title: Sample quality bars
en.summary: Compare sample means from an existing result table in a bar chart.
steps: In EMP 10.4 or later, open Plugins and select Install and enable.
Choose a completed plugin job containing a mean column, such as a Sample quality summary result.
Choose Sample quality bars and select Show result.
en.note: The default view displays the first 30 rows. From EMP 10.2, Settings lets you switch between bars and a table and adjust the row limit.
en.permission: job.result.read reads the selected job’s result table.
en.preview_alt: Bar chart of mean values from the same synthetic samples as the quality table.

title: Groq 模型接口
summary: 把 Groq 接入 EMP 的模型选择器，用自己的 API Key 测试连接。
steps: 在 EMP 10.4 或更高版本，打开「插件」，点击 Groq 的「安装」。已预装时可直接点「设置」。
刷新「模型与 API」，选择 Groq · Plugin，填写自己的 Groq API Key。
检测模型列表，选择账号可用的模型，保存并加载后进行连接测试。
note: 需要可访问 Groq 的网络与有效凭据。旧版可将 plugin.json 放入 plugins/ai-providers/groq/ 后刷新页面。
permission: 调用模型会向 api.groq.com 发送本次提交的内容。下载包只包含服务清单。
preview_alt: Groq 模型配置与连接操作示意。

en.title: Groq model provider
en.summary: Add Groq to the EMP model selector and test the connection with your own API key.
steps: In EMP 10.4 or later, open Plugins and select Install on the Groq card. Choose Settings if it is already installed.
Under Models and API, select Groq · Plugin and enter your own Groq API key.
Fetch the model list, select a model available to your account, then save, load and test the connection.
en.note: Requires access to Groq and valid credentials. In older versions, place plugin.json in plugins/ai-providers/groq/ and refresh the page.
en.permission: Model requests send the submitted content to api.groq.com. The download contains only the provider manifest.
en.preview_alt: Example Groq provider configuration and connection controls.
